Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in understanding the function of antibodies. The agent incorrectly stated that antibodies "directly engulf the pathogens themselves as a defense mechanism," which is not accurate. The correct function of antibodies is to attach to an invading virus as a target marker, allowing other components of the immune system to recognize and attack the pathogen. This misunderstanding led to the incorrect selection of option C instead of the correct option B.
